column1: body|/ˈbɑːdi/|n.|身体；主体|基础|body-parts|the human body::人体;body language::肢体语言|The human body needs time to rest.::人体需要时间休息。|Her body language showed that she felt relaxed.::她的肢体语言表明她感到放松。
head|/hed/|n.|头；负责人；前端|基础|body-parts|shake one's head::摇头;the head of::……的负责人|He shook his head and closed the book.::他摇了摇头，合上了书。|She is the head of our small research team.::她是我们这个小研究团队的负责人。
face|/feɪs/|n.; v.|脸；面对|基础|body-parts|face a problem::面对问题;face to face::面对面|I could see a smile on her face.::我能看到她脸上的笑容。|We need to face the problem together.::我们需要共同面对这个问题。
eye|/aɪ/|n.|眼睛；观察力|基础|body-parts|keep an eye on::留意;eye contact::眼神交流|Please keep an eye on my bag.::请帮我留意一下我的包。|Eye contact can help show that you are listening.::眼神交流可以表明你在倾听。
ear|/ɪr/|n.|耳朵；听觉|基础|body-parts|by ear::凭听觉;an ear for music::音乐听觉能力|She learned to play the tune by ear.::她凭听觉学会了弹奏这支曲子。|He has a good ear for different accents.::他很善于辨别不同的口音。
nose|/noʊz/|n.|鼻子；嗅觉|基础|body-parts|a running nose::流鼻涕;under one's nose::就在眼前|The dog lifted its nose toward the food.::狗把鼻子朝着食物抬起来。|The missing note was right under my nose.::那张找不到的便条就在我眼前。

mouth|/maʊθ/|n.|嘴；开口；河口|基础|body-parts|open one's mouth::张嘴;the mouth of a river::河口|She opened her mouth to answer the question.::她张嘴回答问题。|The village stands near the mouth of the river.::这个村庄坐落在河口附近。
tooth|/tuːθ/|n.|牙齿；齿状部分|基础|body-parts|a front tooth::门牙;brush one's teeth::刷牙|The child has lost a front tooth.::这个孩子掉了一颗门牙。|I brush my teeth before going to bed.::我睡觉前刷牙。
tongue|/tʌŋ/|n.|舌头；语言|基础|body-parts|mother tongue::母语;hold one's tongue::保持沉默|English is not her mother tongue.::英语不是她的母语。|The cat touched the milk with its tongue.::猫用舌头碰了碰牛奶。
skin|/skɪn/|n.|皮肤；表皮|基础|body-parts|dry skin::干燥的皮肤;orange skin::橙子皮|The cold air made her skin feel dry.::冷空气让她觉得皮肤干燥。|The fruit has a thin, smooth skin.::这种水果的表皮薄而光滑。
hand|/hænd/|n.; v.|手；帮助；递交|基础|body-parts|by hand::手工;give someone a hand::帮某人一把|The old map was drawn by hand.::这张旧地图是手绘的。|Could you hand me the blue notebook?::你能把那本蓝色笔记本递给我吗？

finger|/ˈfɪŋɡər/|n.|手指|基础|body-parts|point a finger::用手指指;run one's fingers through::用手指梳过|She pointed a finger at the correct answer.::她用手指指着正确答案。|He hurt his finger while moving the chair.::他搬椅子时伤到了手指。
arm|/ɑːrm/|n.|手臂；扶手；分支|基础|body-parts|raise an arm::举起手臂;the arm of a chair::椅子的扶手|She raised her arm to ask a question.::她举起手臂提问。|The child fell asleep in his father's arms.::孩子在父亲的怀抱中睡着了。
leg|/leɡ/|n.|腿；支撑脚；一段行程|基础|body-parts|a broken leg::骨折的腿;the first leg::第一段行程|The table has one leg shorter than the others.::这张桌子有一条腿比其他腿短。|The first leg of our journey was by train.::我们旅程的第一段乘坐火车。
foot|/fʊt/|n.|脚；底部；英尺|基础|body-parts|on foot::步行;at the foot of::在……脚下|We explored the old town on foot.::我们步行游览了古镇。|A small house stands at the foot of the hill.::山脚下有一栋小房子。
bone|/boʊn/|n.|骨头；骨骼|基础|body-parts|a broken bone::骨折;skin and bone::瘦骨嶙峋|The museum displays the bones of a large animal.::博物馆展出了一种大型动物的骨骼。|The X-ray showed that no bone was broken.::X光片显示没有骨头断裂。
muscle|/ˈmʌsəl/|n.|肌肉；力量|四级|body-parts|a leg muscle::腿部肌肉;muscle strength::肌肉力量|He felt a pain in his leg muscle.::他感到腿部肌肉疼痛。|The study measured changes in muscle strength.::研究测量了肌肉力量的变化。

brain|/breɪn/|n.|大脑；智力|基础|body-parts|the human brain::人脑;brain activity::大脑活动|The human brain processes information in many ways.::人脑以多种方式处理信息。|The researchers recorded brain activity during the task.::研究人员记录了任务期间的大脑活动。
blood|/blʌd/|n.|血；血液|基础|body-parts|blood pressure::血压;a blood test::血液检查|Blood carries oxygen around the body.::血液将氧气输送到全身。|The nurse recorded the results of the blood test.::护士记录了血液检查的结果。
heart|/hɑːrt/|n.|心脏；内心；中心|基础|body-parts|by heart::凭记忆;at the heart of::在……的核心|She knows the whole poem by heart.::她能背诵整首诗。|Trust is at the heart of their friendship.::信任是他们友谊的核心。
lung|/lʌŋ/|n.|肺|基础|body-parts|lung function::肺功能;the left lung::左肺|Air enters the lungs when we breathe in.::我们吸气时，空气进入肺部。|The report describes changes in lung function.::报告描述了肺功能的变化。

stomach|/ˈstʌmək/|n.|胃；腹部|基础|body-parts|an empty stomach::空腹;a stomach ache::胃痛|I did not want to travel on an empty stomach.::我不想空着肚子旅行。|She said her stomach felt uncomfortable after lunch.::她说午饭后胃部感到不舒服。

sight|/saɪt/|n.|视力；看见；景象|基础|senses|at first sight::乍一看;lose sight of::看不见；忽视|At first sight, the two pictures look identical.::乍一看，这两幅画似乎完全相同。|We must not lose sight of our main objective.::我们不能忽视主要目标。

hearing|/ˈhɪrɪŋ/|n.|听力；听证会|基础|senses|good hearing::良好的听力;a public hearing::公开听证会|The dog's hearing is better than mine.::那只狗的听力比我好。|Residents spoke at a public hearing about the plan.::居民在关于这项计划的公开听证会上发言。
smell|/smel/|n.; v.|气味；闻到|基础|senses|a pleasant smell::宜人的气味;smell of::有……的气味|The kitchen was filled with the smell of bread.::厨房里充满了面包的香味。|I can smell rain in the warm air.::我能在温暖的空气中闻到雨的气息。
taste|/teɪst/|n.; v.|味道；品味；品尝|基础|senses|a sweet taste::甜味;personal taste::个人品味|The soup has a slightly sweet taste.::这道汤略带甜味。|Your choice of colors reflects your personal taste.::你对颜色的选择反映了个人品味。

touch|/tʌtʃ/|n.; v.|触摸；接触；使感动|基础|senses|keep in touch::保持联系;at the touch of::一触……就|Please do not touch the surface while it is hot.::表面还烫的时候请勿触摸。|We still keep in touch after leaving school.::离开学校后，我们仍保持联系。
pain|/peɪn/|n.|疼痛；痛苦|基础|health|in pain::疼痛中;cause pain::造成痛苦|He felt a sharp pain in his shoulder.::他的肩膀感到一阵剧痛。|The loss caused pain for the whole family.::这一损失令全家人痛苦。

injury|/ˈɪndʒəri/|n.|伤；损伤|基础|health|a serious injury::重伤;recover from an injury::伤后恢复|The player returned after recovering from an injury.::这名球员伤愈后回归。|The report explains how the injury occurred.::报告解释了这次伤是如何发生的。

recover|/rɪˈkʌvər/|v.|恢复；找回|基础|health|recover from::从……中恢复;recover lost files::恢复丢失的文件|The village took years to recover from the flood.::村庄花了数年才从洪灾中恢复。|The program helped us recover the lost files.::这个程序帮助我们恢复了丢失的文件。
